title: Associate Data Scientist
description: National competency certification under Indonesia's SKKNI standard, covering 9 competency units across the data science lifecycle - from data labeling and collection to validation, feature construction, and model evaluation.

title: McKinsey.org Forward Program
description: Practical business leadership and problem-solving program developed by McKinsey experts, covering structured problem solving, digital communication, adaptability, and leadership.

title: Machine Learning Specialization
description: Three-course foundational specialization covering supervised learning (regression, neural networks, decision trees), unsupervised learning (clustering, recommender systems), and best practices for building ML systems, taught by Andrew Ng.

title: DeepLearning.AI TensorFlow Developer
description: Four-course professional program covering neural networks, CNNs for computer vision, NLP, and time series forecasting with TensorFlow - preparation for the Google TensorFlow Developer Certificate exam.

title: TensorFlow: Advanced Techniques Specialization
description: Four-course specialization on advanced TensorFlow techniques, custom models, layers, and loss functions with tf.keras, custom training loops, and computer vision with Siamese networks and GANs.

title: TensorFlow: Data and Deployment
description: Four-course specialization on deploying TensorFlow models to browsers with TensorFlow.js, mobile and embedded devices, building data pipelines with TFDS, and advanced serving with TensorFlow Serving, Hub, and TensorBoard.

title: Generative AI for Everyone
description: Foundational program on Generative AI capabilities, LLMs, prompt engineering, generative AI project lifecycle, business opportunities, and safety considerations taught by Andrew Ng.

title: Mathematics for Machine Learning and Data Science Specialization
description: Three-course specialization covering linear algebra, calculus, probability, and statistics foundational to machine learning algorithms and neural network optimization.

title: SQL Server for Intermediate
description: Intermediate-level coursework covering complex queries, security management, indexing and query optimization, views, SQL extensions and stored procedures, backup and recovery, and data transfer.

title: Belajar Analisis Data dengan Python
description: Hands-on certification on data wrangling, exploratory data analysis (EDA), and data visualization using Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, and Seaborn.

title: Share Data Through the Art of Visualization
description: Professional certificate course on storytelling with data, dynamic dashboards, and visual design principles in Tableau and spreadsheets.

title: Analyze Data to Answer Questions
description: Coursework on performing complex calculations and data analysis using SQL and spreadsheets to answer business questions.

title: Process Data from Dirty to Clean
description: Comprehensive data cleaning, validation, integrity verification, and transformation using SQL and spreadsheet tools.

title: Introduction to Git and GitHub
description: Coursework covering Git version control workflows, branching, rebasing, remote collaboration, and pull request management on GitHub.

title: Using Python to Interact with the Operating System
description: Scripting with Python to automate file operations, regex parsing, subprocess management, and system tasks across Linux and Windows.

title: Crash Course on Python
description: Foundational programming and algorithmic problem solving with Python, object-oriented concepts, and basic data structures.
